features.quote: Max wall time per episode: 8–12 minutes.
Max total tokens: 40k–80k depending on model cost.
Stop if: same test failure observed at least 3 times, same file/function edited at least 3 times, no new hypothesis appears in assistant messages, and automated repetition score exceeds threshold.
features.justification_quote: For cheap smoke tests, you may use early stopping after a clear degradation pattern.

features.quote: Use automated online loop detector to stop severe cases early.
features.justification_quote: Do not use early stopping for final severity leaderboard unless consistently applied.
